prompt: Write projects/labels/plan.md from source.md. Replace the incomplete draft. Do not implement the plan.
setup: git init -q -b eval
git config user.email eval@example.com && git config user.name 'Eval Bot'
mkdir -p projects/labels contracts

printf '%s\n' '# Label service — agreed design' '' 'Build a Go HTTP application backed by MySQL 8.' 'Slice outcomes are creating a label and retrieving a stored label.' 'POST /labels validates a SKU with Catalog, stores the label, and returns 201.' 'Catalog 503 produces 503 with no label stored; GET /labels/{id} returns a stored label.' 'Use the approved contracts/catalog-v1.json contract.' 'The planned acceptance runner will load docs/specs/labels.feature directly.' 'Its scenarios will call the running application'\''s HTTP endpoint, use real MySQL, and send production Catalog-client requests to a local protocol mock.' 'No launchers, fixtures, migrations, or test harness have been implemented.' > source.md

printf '%s\n' 'POST /labels accepts {"sku":"sku-1"}. A SKU contains 1–64 ASCII letters, digits, or hyphens.' 'Stored labels contain a generated UUIDv4 id and sku. POST returns 201 with that object; GET /labels/{id} returns 200 with the same object.' 'Invalid requests return 400 {"error":"invalid_request"} before any Catalog call or database write. Unknown labels return 404 {"error":"not_found"}.' 'Catalog failures and timeouts return 503 {"error":"catalog_unavailable"} without storing a label. MySQL failures return 500 {"error":"storage_unavailable"}.' 'Repeated valid POST requests create distinct labels. Authentication and additional Catalog outcomes are outside this fixture'\''s scope.' >> source.md

printf '%s\n' '{"version":"catalog-v1","request":{"method":"GET","path":"/v1/items/{sku}"},"responses":{"200":{"sku":"sku-1","name":"Example"},"503":{"error":"unavailable"}}}' > contracts/catalog-v1.json

printf '%s\n' '# Labels — Plan' '' '## Local Running and Integration Tests' '' 'Handler-only tests are sufficient; no running application is planned.' '' '## Implementation' '' '### Slice 1: Labels' '' '- [ ] **M1.1**: Labels can be created.' '' '## Notes' '' 'Draft.' > projects/labels/plan.md
git add . && git commit -q -m 'evaluation fixture'

Acceptance verification identifies the real HTTP entrypoint, MySQL, and production Catalog client.
The plan uses the acceptance scenarios for integration evidence where they exercise that complete path.
The plan keeps product scenario text in one owning feature rather than copying it into another suite.
The shared local-running section identifies the startup command.
The shared local-running section defines bounded readiness checks.
The shared local-running section identifies how migrations are run.
The shared local-running section identifies how seed data is loaded.
The shared local-running section identifies how state is reset.
The shared local-running section identifies the integration-test command.
The shared local-running section identifies how teardown is invoked.
Automated tests isolate their state and cleanup from manual developer data.
The local path uses synthetic credentials and local upstreams after dependency bootstrap.
The plan names a mock-conformance check against contracts/catalog-v1.json.

prompt: Write projects/operations-guide/plan.md from source.md. Do not implement the plan.
setup: git init -q -b eval
git config user.email eval@example.com && git config user.name 'Eval Bot'
mkdir -p projects/operations-guide docs

printf '%s\n' '# Improve the operations guide' '' 'Revise docs/operations.md to explain the existing backup and recovery procedure.' 'This is documentation-only work. No application behavior or dependencies change.' 'Use the existing make check-docs target. Do not introduce new runtime infrastructure.' > source.md

printf '%s\n' 'Existing procedure: ops stop; ops backup --output PATH; ops restore --input PATH; ops start; confirm ops status reports healthy.' 'These commands already exist. Only documentation changes are requested.' >> source.md
printf '%s\n' '# Operations' '' 'Back up the data. Restore it when needed.' > docs/operations.md
printf '%s\n' 'check-docs:' '	@test -s docs/operations.md' > Makefile
printf '%s\n' '# Operations guide — Plan' '' '## Notes' '' 'Draft.' > projects/operations-guide/plan.md
git add . && git commit -q -m 'evaluation fixture'
checks: The plan records why a local application runtime and service-level integration harness do not apply.
The plan uses make check-docs to verify the documentation change.
The plan leaves container stacks, databases, and mock services outside the work.
The plan does not create product acceptance scenarios for unchanged application behavior.
verify: node -e 'const a=require("node:assert/strict"),f=require("node:fs");const s=f.readFileSync("projects/operations-guide/plan.md","utf8");a.match(s,/make check-docs/);a.match(s,/^## Local Running and Integration Tests\s*$/m);'
git diff --exit-code HEAD -- source.md docs/operations.md Makefile
